title: Niagara Falls USA & Canada Tour with Cave, Boat Ride & Skylon
includes: Narrated driving experience of both Niagara Falls Canada and the USA
Comprehensive walking tour of Goat Island, Including: Luna Island and Terrapin Point
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on an exhilarating journey that straddles two countries in just one day with this comprehensive Niagara Falls tour. Your adventure begins with a convenient hotel pick-up ready to explore the natural beauty and historical significance of the American side of the Falls. Your first stop is Goat Island, where you'll enjoy a quick walking tour that immerses you in the breathtaking landscapes and panoramic views. Explore Luna Island, then head to Terrapin Point. The adventure deepens into the Cave of the Winds. After that you´ll cross into Canada with time to relax and indulge in a delicious buffet lunch at the Skylon Tower with a panoramic view from the Tower´s Observation Deck. Continue with a scenic drive along Niagara Parkway with stunning views of the River and includes a stop at Table Rock. Finally, the famous Niagara Boat Cruise, sail right up the base of the Horseshoe Falls.
